shortDescription: Coinglass data shows that if ETH breaks above $2,555, cumulative short liquidations across major centralized exchanges would reach $988 million. According to ChainCatcher, if ETH falls below $2,320, cumulative long liquidations across major centralized exchanges would reach $708 million.
